item.text: {"case_id":"SHC088","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C22","C03","C23"],"selected_candidate_label":"C22","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C22 is the direct, expressly cited predecessor and supplies most of the child's concrete drafting structure and language: the same continuing Tariff Commission investigation, expiration of the prior year's almond fees, a new annual report, matching findings of threatened interference and necessity, and an operative fee provision using the same product description, entry terminology, ad valorem cap, annual period, and additional-duties clause. The child updates the dates and almond threshold, simplifies the almond fee to apply only above 5,000,000 pounds, and adds filberts. C03 and C23 are earlier iterations of the same almond-fee machinery but are less immediate and less closely matched.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Import fees on shelled almonds and blanched, roasted, or otherwise prepared or preserved almonds (not including almond paste) imposed pursuant to the President's proclamation of September 29, 1953 ... will cease to apply ... after September 30, 1954","parent_excerpt":"Import fees on shelled almonds and blanched, roasted, or otherwise prepared or preserved almonds (not including almond paste) imposed pursuant to the President's proclamation of September 27, 1952 ... will cease to apply ... after September 30, 1953","explanation":"The child closely reproduces C22's expiration recital while advancing the referenced proclamation and expiration date by one year."},{"child_excerpt":"on the basis of such report of September 24, 1954, I find that shelled almonds, and blanched, roasted, or otherwise prepared or preserved almonds (not including almond paste) ... are practically certain to be imported ... during the period October 1, 1954, to September 30, 1955 ... as to render or tend to render ineffective, or materially interfere with, the programs undertaken by the Department of Agriculture","parent_excerpt":"on the basis of such report of September 21, 1953, I find that shelled almonds, and blanched, roasted, or otherwise prepared or preserved almonds (not including almond paste) are practically certain to be imported ... during the period October 1, 1953 to September 30, 1954 ... as to render or tend to render ineffective, or materially interfere with the program undertaken by the Department of Agriculture","explanation":"This is a highly specific parallel factual finding with the report date and annual coverage period updated and filberts added."},{"child_excerpt":"a fee of 10 cents per pound, but not more than 50 per centum ad valorem, shall be imposed upon shelled almonds and blanched, roasted, or otherwise prepared or preserved almonds (not including almond paste) entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption during the period October 1, 1954, to September 30, 1955 ... in excess of an aggregate quantity of 5,000,000 pounds","parent_excerpt":"a fee of 10 cents per pound, but not more than 50 per centum ad valorem, shall be imposed upon such almonds entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption during such period in excess of an aggregate quantity of 7,000,000 pounds","explanation":"The child reuses C22's operative fee formula and customs-entry machinery, changing the threshold and annual dates."},{"child_excerpt":"The said fees shall be in addition to any other duties imposed on the importation of such almonds and filberts.","parent_excerpt":"The said fees
